shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app -type f && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat /workspace/next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

grep -oE "updateTag|revalidateTag|revalidatePath|cacheTag|cacheLife" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/compiled/*/next-cache.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "---EXPORTS in next/cache---"; grep -rEo "(updateTag|revalidateTag|revalidatePath|cacheTag|cacheLife|refresh)\b" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/exported-rsc.jsm 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "---search updateTag def---"; grep -rl "updateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v docs | head -20

echo "=== next/cache exports ==="; grep -oE "unstable_cache|updateTag|revalidateTag|cacheTag|revalidatePath" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo; echo "=== next/cache entry re-exports these? ==="; node -e "const c=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/cache.js'); console.log(Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/cache|revalidate|update|refresh/i.test(k)))" 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "unstable_cache\|updateTag" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo; echo "=== CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md ==="; cat /workspace/CLAUDE.md /workspace/GEMINI.md; echo; echo "=== opencode.json ==="; cat /workspace/opencode.json
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== TSC EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -45; echo "=== BUILD EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
